name: Bridge railings and brook boundary walls
observations: Repeated slim grey metal vertical bars with a top rail run across bridge footway.
Short concrete/stone-like plinth supports rails; notices/banners hang from some spans in older image.
Brick boundary walls and timber/metal fencing continue on adjoining banks.
Build repeatable rail sections with end posts, leaving watercourse/side access unobstructed.
Weathering/poster banners are dated optional details, not structural spacing evidence.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
